title: AMD Ryzen Eco Mode Deep-Dive & Benchmarks on R9 7950X (Zen 4)
summary: Gamers Nexus benchmarks the Ryzen 9 7950X in its BIOS Eco Mode presets (65W, 105W and stock 170W). It measures the performance cost against the power and heat savings.
why: Cited as evidence that Eco Mode gives large power savings for a small performance loss on Zen 4.

quote.text: So just enable it and enjoy way more reasonable and efficient power usage with basically almost the same performance.
